To detect one bit error at receiver we can use parity checker. For detection of error an extra bit, known as parity bit, is attached to each code word to make the number of 1’s in the code even (in case of even parity) or odd (in case of odd parity). For n-bit data, we use n-bit parity generator at the trans- mitter end. With 1 parity bit and n-bit data, total n + 1 bit will be transmitted. At the receiving end n + 1 parity checker circuit will be used to check correctness of the data. For even parity transmission, parity bit will be made 1 or 0 based on the data, so that total n + 1 bits will have even number of 1’s. For example, if we want to transmit data 1011 by even parity transmission, then we will use parity bit as 1, so data will have even number of 1’s, i.e., data trans- mitted will be 11011.
